## Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves
What problem would this feature solve? What's your use case or workflow limitation?

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you'd like the feature or tool to work. Include CLI arguments, config options, or behavior where relevant.

## Alternative Solutions
Any alternative approaches or workarounds you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add mockups, examples, model interaction traces, or other context here.

## Priority
- [ ] Low
- [ ] Medium
- [ ] High
